headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: A Houthi missile hit Riyadh airport again, wounding dozens, and Trump said the US "may" join Saudi strikes on the Houthis and would "take a look" at his no-strikes-before-the-midterms pledge. The IRGC claims an unnamed supertanker hit a mine on an "unauthorized" Hormuz route, unconfirmed like its NV Sunshine claim. No tripwire fired and odds are unchanged; war by Nov. 3 stays at 55%.

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
Iran ends strait tolls and permits, or declares Hormuz open to all shipping
Iran offers a concrete cut in enrichment capacity, in text or on the record
